The '''Daggersand Ridges''' was a location above the [[Skulljaw Grottoes]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]].<ref name="Outer Rim Worlds" /> By [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]],<ref name="Date">[[Tsyr]] is killed during the events of the ''[[Star Wars: Republic]]'' comic arc [[Star Wars: Rite of Passage|Rite of Passage]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]]. Therefore the duel between Tsyr and Ma'kis'shaalas must have taken place before then.</ref> the [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] [[Ma'kis'shaalas/Legends|Ma'kis'shaalas]] had left the [[Morgukai]], a secret society based on Kintan, to join the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. After becoming a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], Ma'kis'shaalas returned to Kintan and met with [[Tsyr]], a leader among the Morqukai. Outraged by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] decision to leave the group, Tsyr attacked Ma'kis'shaalas and the two fought across the Daggersand Ridges until Tsyr lost his footing and fell into the Skulljaw Grottoes below. Both survived the experience but never spoke to each other again.<ref name="Outer Rim Worlds" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Daggersand Ridges were mentioned in ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[Wizards of the Coast]]<ref name="Outer Rim Worlds" /> in [[March]] [[2004]].<ref name="Outer Rim Worlds Date">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=products/swrpgacc/888870000|text=Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds}}</ref>
